edit.description: `locus_member_sites` (:1071) is the guard's shell edge walking every declared locus root, reached once per `PostToolUse` call from `shell_edge_findings` (:1027, `main.rs:391`). Its doc states the work count in prose — "A bounded walk, one per locus root, never the whole tree: a per-tool-call cost is paid on every call a session makes" — and nothing asserts it: the module carries no counter, so a re-walk per candidate file, a second walk per glob, or a collapse to one `.`-rooted whole-tree walk all ship green. Give it the pin every sibling already carries: install.rs's first `thread_local!` block holding a `Cell<usize>` walk counter, a `#[must_use] pub fn locus_member_site_walk_count()` accessor in the doc form `compose::repo_file_set_count` (`compose.rs:59`) and `import::walk_count` (`import.rs:142`) use, and the increment as the walk's first statement — placed after the `compile_glob` guard that `continue`s before any `WalkDir` is built, so the counted quantity is exactly the walks performed. Additive: no call site, no returned `Vec<drift::LocusMemberSite>` and no finding changes. The promoted prose then shrinks to name the pin (`engineering.md`, "Narration is the ladder's bottom rung" — promoted scaffolding shrinks), keeping the two rationale sentences the count cannot express: why `import`'s index is the wrong reuse, and why the caller's locus set carries no `.`-rooted locus.

The cost-pin home across verbs — it already holds emit's lock-parse and manifest-read pins beside check's walk pins — gains the guard edge's. Drive the real `install::shell_edge_findings` over a tempdir harness whose `.temper/lock.toml` carries a root contract with a `locus-declared` clause (the opt-in `guarded_loci` reads, `main.rs:743`) and two `install::GuardedLocus` values at distinct roots (`.claude/rules`, `.claude/skills`), each root holding a file the lock declares no member for. Assert the walk delta is exactly 2 — one per locus root: a per-file or per-glob re-walk overshoots, and a widened `.`-rooted whole-tree walk undershoots at 1, so the count catches the regression in both directions. Non-vacuity (`engineering.md`, "A green verdict is proven non-vacuous"): assert the returned report is `Some` and names both strays before pinning the count, so a fixture whose walk found nothing cannot pass. The module header's enumeration gains the guard edge's pin; its opening line, which still scopes the file to `check` alone while emit's pins already live here, is the riding prose cite this entry discharges.

summary: The guard's per-tool-call locus walk claims "one walk per locus root, never the whole tree" in prose alone — no count pins it.

per.section: Cost scale is hoisted, and pinned by count

tests.asserts: a shell-edge guard run over two declared locus roots walks exactly twice — one per root — after the report is shown to name a stray found under each

acceptance: `cargo test` green with the new pin asserting a walk delta of exactly one per declared locus root over a real `shell_edge_findings` run, and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
notes: Sibling of c4a99757 one module over, on a hotter path: the shell edge fires per tool call, where `repo_file_set` fires once per `check`. install.rs gains its first thread_local; six modules already carry the shape (compose, graph, drift, glob, import, read, json_manifest). `src/install.rs` overlaps only INSTALL-LIFTS-A-REGISTRATION-MEMBER, fork-held on `(hook-member-identity)` and unpickable, so no wave collides. scoped at df1012f8
